data.narrative:
Twenty, a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Joe Lin, Leo Olson, Skyler Onken, and Pete Sorrentino, has raised $38M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 same-sector and same/adjacent-stage companies, comprising 8 private and 2 public comparables. Notable private peers include Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI; public comps are DRSHF and IDEAFORGE.NS.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base of $38M and applying a 2.0x Series A step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $76M. Peer-median analysis across the 10-company set yields a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range of $125M to $3.0B. Sample peers at Series B include Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), and Castelion and Defense Unicorns (both $1.0B).

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $65M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $538M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Twenty's relative maturity within the peer cohort, product-market fit trajectory, and customer concentration. Stage-progression and peer median methods produce divergent results; reconciling this gap requires clarity on Twenty's revenue, customer traction, and defensibility relative to the peer set.
